title: Horizon and Static
author: Marguerite Oyelaran
blurb: Vesper Winterbourne, the last human technician on an automated relay station, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
